_doc: Avalanche events for the slab-fracture-mode evaluation (examples/evaluate_slab_crack_modes.py). Paths are relative to data/<slope>/, which must hold the data/little_prof layout: spatial/cluster_map.tif, dem_1m.tif, boundaries/start_zone.kml, and the calibration preset's features_dir with all_start_zone_features_<date>.csv and meloche_features_all_<date>.csv. role: 'calibration' if any model knob was fitted on the event (scores are reported, never pooled as validation), 'validation' otherwise. ski: non-trigger points JSON (points_lat_lon) or null.

events.note: Survey polygon 5 810 m2; avachain calibration 2026-11-17.1 was fitted on it.
